title: Ghalegay Buddha
subtitle: Seated Buddha carved in a rock face beside the Mingora-Barikot road, Lower Swat

landmark.name: Ghalegay Buddha (rock relief)
edits: The rock is the OSM tourism node 'Buddah' (tourism=attraction) at 34.70590 N, 72.26045 E, 18 m from the N-95 centre line; the point was checked against the photos (the carved panel faces the road).
The carved boulder is 6.80 m x 3.20 m with a depth of 0.85 m (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa DOAM record 4672); the carved face is read as the 6.80 m height by the 3.20 m width, which the record does not state.
The rock mass behind the panel and the surrounding outcrop are estimated from the photos.

The seated figure, its halo, shoulders, crossed legs and hands are estimated raised geometry (about 3.1 m wide, 4.9 m high to the halo top); the photos show a figure of similar proportion, with the face weathered.
The DOAM record gives 34.69915 N, 72.26303 E for the same carving ('Ghaligai-I'), about 0.8 km from the OSM node; the photos and the road position match the OSM node, so the node is used.
The terrace is 0 (the rock face is not levelled); the figure stands on the real slope about 1.2 m above the ground, estimated from the photos.

sources.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa DOAM site record 4672 (Ghaligai-I, Buddhist rock carvings, Swat)
sources.use: boulder size 6.80 m x 3.20 m, depth 0.85 m, date 7th-8th century CE, dhyani mudra, slight erosion
sources.licence: Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa record; facts only, no image used

osm_use: the N-95 trunk road from Barikot to Mingora (the last 0.6 km before the rock), and the OSM tourism node 'Buddah' at the rock
